primary_interest.quote: I saw your note said voice AI agents for outbound qualification.

use_case.quote: We want AI agents that call out, confirm the lead is real, ask about trip size, dates, budget, and then hand off the qualified ones to a human.

inference_framing.quote: I'm not looking to buy an LLM API as its own thing. But the voice agent needs one behind it

inference_raised_by.quote: Fifteen agents, so different scripts and probably different models per agent?

competitors_inference.quote: I've been comparing OpenAI direct and Fireworks for that.

decision_criteria.quote: we need to swap between several open models.

stated_reason.quote: A chunk of the calls would be to leads in India, and the data has to stay in India.
